name: Causeway: Ruined Shrines
summary: A shattered Dragorn ceremonial shrine complex, desecrated by Muramite forces and corrupted by Discord fissures.
description: The Ruined Shrines were once sacred Dragorn ceremonial sites honoring noble lineage and ancestral rites. Muramite forces destroyed the shrines during their invasion, leaving broken altars, collapsed sanctuaries, and corrupted ceremonial stones. Discord fissures now pulse through the ruins, animating shattered statues and warping Dragorn relics. Resistance fighters hide among the ruins, while Muramite patrols attempt to suppress arcane instability.
